name: Proper Shaders
author: Junior_Djjr, Jéssica Natália
description: Modern lighting, shadows, reflections and surface rendering. The central graphics upgrade in Forged.
note: This build uses the supplied October 2026 Medium presets, with SimulateHDR disabled to work with the chosen SkyGfx colour treatment. Third-party shader credits remain in the original package.

name: SleekGraphics • preset 2
author: pedrowav
description: The colour and atmosphere reference for this build, using the second SkyGfx preset alongside its GraphicsTweaker settings.
note: Preset 2 is loaded as skygfx1.ini. The buildingPipe and vehiclePipe overrides are commented out for Proper Shaders. The Extended-only stochasticTexturing option is also commented out.

name: SkyGfx
author: aap, SkyGfx contributors
description: Restores console rendering features and supplies the classic San Andreas colour treatment used by the SleekGraphics preset.
note: Normal SkyGfx 4.2b is the graphics base documented for this build.

name: GraphicsTweaker
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Configurable adjustments to the game’s graphics. This collection keeps the settings supplied with SleekGraphics.

name: [24H] Refixed Original Timecycle
author: Horsequaad2122, aap, Dante
description: A full-day timecycle based on the original game’s colours, supplying the changing weather and lighting behind the graphics preset.
note: The release page credits the original timecycle24 and its fork. Use the supplied pack configuration to retain the intended look.

name: RoSA Project Evolved
author: Jéssica Natália, RoSA contributors
description: The main world texture replacement: roads, buildings, signs and surfaces rebuilt around the original art direction.
note: September supporter edition in this collection. Evolved is led by Jéssica Natália, building on RoSA by dima001rus and MaKs_IV and the Reborn team. The source page lists the complete texture and legacy credits.

name: Proper Player Retex
author: Jéssica Natália, Junior_Djjr, OjTrue, Zeneric, Jão, François Declasse
description: Higher-resolution textures for CJ and his clothing, keeping his familiar appearance.

name: Proper Fixes
author: StreetFonso, Hysen, Tripaseca, Junior_Djjr, Jéssica Natália, Aal, MJkun17, KaiQ, Zeneric
description: Community fixes for map geometry, textures and other original-game errors. Includes work that helps modern lighting behave correctly on the map.
note: Use the RoSA-compatible edition and keep its Mod Loader priority above RoSA. The source page contains additional component credits.

name: Project2DFX
author: ThirteenAG, TJGM
description: Distant light sources and extended visual detail give the skyline more depth after dark.

name: SkyGrad
author: Wesser
description: Softens visible banding in the sky’s colour gradients.

name: SA Blur
author: gta.bullet
description: Disables the original high-speed blur so driving stays clear.
note: Installed as sa-blur.asi in the game directory.

name: Custom PostFX Shaders
author: ep1h
description: A loader for custom fullscreen post-processing shaders.
note: Installed as gta-sa-postfx.asi. The active shader chain depends on the included gta-sa-postfx.cfg; its presence alone does not identify which effects are enabled.

name: DrIVe Mod
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Break a window to steal a car, pick a lock through a minigame, and hotwire parked vehicles. Adds driving actions and animations, including working the steering wheel.
note: The lockpicking, window-breaking and driving features are part of this edition. The Fender Ketchup workaround is a temporary 30 FPS cap, not removal of DrIVe.

name: VehIK 1.2b
author: ZZPuma
description: Inverse-kinematics animation brings hands and feet into contact with vehicle controls, including steering and pedals.
note: The visible result also depends on the vehicle model’s supported features.

name: VehDeform 1.3c
author: ZZPuma
description: Car bodywork deforms dynamically after impacts.
note: This collection uses VehDeform, not the separately discussed LocalDent mod.

name: Car Crash Inertia
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Adds the possibility of being thrown through the windscreen during a hard collision.

name: Trucks with Trailers
author: Razzer.exe
description: Adds trucks towing trailers to ordinary traffic.

name: Real Traffic Fix
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Changes traffic behaviour to address awkward braking, acceleration and reactions around other vehicles.
note: The screenshot confirms the folder name, not the exact release. This source is Junior_Djjr’s established version; a different implementation with the same name also exists.

name: Rear Lights Mod
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Adds rear-light effects during driving and nitro use.
note: Effects and activation conditions are controlled by the included INI.

name: Pay’N’Spray Extended
author: vladvo
description: Choose vehicle colours and paintjobs, or pay for repairs separately without automatically repainting the car.

name: Taxi Ride
author: sarafsuhail
description: Ride as a passenger and let a taxi take you to your destination.
note: The installed folder is named Taxi Ride. The linked original project documents its controls and passenger system.

name: Inside the Plane
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Adds an interior view during purchased airline journeys between the cities.

name: Urbanize
author: Junior_Djjr, Jéssica Natália, Urbanize contributors
description: Adds ambient people and activities to places that otherwise feel empty, making the streets and public spaces busier.
note: Animations and other contributed assets are credited in the original release.

name: Busy Pedestrians • Peds Events Project
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Adds everyday pedestrian activities and scenes around San Andreas, from workers to people spending time outdoors.
note: Features depend on the installed release and enabled scripts. Its source page maintains the current changelog.

name: Doorway Life
author: LKbosss
description: Adds life around doorways and building entrances.

name: Rubbish GTA 4
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Street litter appears around pedestrian areas, with different kinds of rubbish in different neighbourhoods.

name: Fireflies at Night
author: akiri
description: Fireflies appear in rural and natural areas after dark.
note: Installed under the firefly folder.

name: Insects Mod
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Small insects appear around the map, with more activity in natural areas than in the city.

name: Motel Mod
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Use motels to rest, advance time and restore health.
note: Additional room features depend on its configuration.

name: Model Variations
author: ViperJohnGR (cjfan_)
description: A framework for varying pedestrian, vehicle and weapon models according to configured rules.
note: The framework does not itself prove that every optional model pack is installed. Only the variations supplied in this collection are intended.

name: Friendly Triads and Los Aztecas Fix
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Makes the Triads and Los Aztecas friendly at the appropriate points in the story.

name: The Holster on the Cops
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146), AverageChan
description: Visible holstered sidearms and batons add equipment detail to police officers.

name: Store Robbery v3
author: TrushinVlad
description: Adds shop robberies inspired by GTA V.

name: Manual DriveBy Refixed
author: CatchyKetchup, ThirteenAG, Junior_Djjr, Zacthe_nerd
description: Free aiming and shooting from vehicles, with support for additional weapon types.
note: CatchyKetchup’s revised edition builds on Manual Driveby Remake.

name: UltimateFP
author: peter_99
description: Optional first-person camera for on-foot play, vehicles and scripted sequences.
note: The camera can be switched in game. It is still a developing mod; the release page links the author’s current builds.

name: SleekMovement
author: pedrowav
description: Movement and camera changes intended to give classic San Andreas a more modern feel.
note: The author’s showcase is linked here. The download shared during setup was in The Modders Collective Discord.

name: SA.LeedsMoveset
author: Flentric
description: Brings movement behaviour inspired by the Stories games to San Andreas.
note: Used alongside the adapted animation set selected during setup. Avoid replacing the pack’s animation files with a second complete set.

name: eCoJ’s Mix of GTA 5 Anims
author: eCoJ, credited animation contributors
description: The selected character animation mix, stored in the Animations folder.
note: The source package has the individual animation credits. This entry follows the animation set selected during setup; the folder name alone does not establish its exact revision.

name: ImprovedMove
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Adjusts movement and animation blending, with configurable transitions and movement behaviour.
note: Present again in the latest inventory, despite having been removed during an earlier round of testing.

name: Camera Settings
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Adjusts camera position, distance and tilt, with optional motion during driving and crashes.

name: HeadTracking
author: Source not identified
description: An installed movement-related component listed as HeadTracking.
note: The folder is recorded so it is not omitted. Its exact package, behaviour and author still need the original readme; a similarly named mod has not been substituted.

name: SA ShakeFX
author: zFlowy, Birds
description: Camera reactions for driving, gunfire, close passes and hard landings.
note: Individual effects are configurable.

name: SA.StoriesDeathCam
author: Flentric
description: A death-camera modification inspired by the Stories games.

name: Smart Health Recovery
author: peter_99
description: Configurable health recovery intended to fit normal play.
note: Listed as Smart_Health_Recovery in the installed collection. Recovery behaviour follows the supplied configuration.

name: Faster Clothes Change
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Skips CJ repeatedly walking into and out of the changing room while you try on clothes.

name: Food Eating Fix
author: Junior_Djjr, M. Osborn, Renato Russo
description: Shows the appropriate food in CJ’s hand during eating animations.

name: Faithful Weapons Pack
author: ThePedro004, credited weapon artists
description: Replaces the weapon set with more detailed models chosen to resemble the originals.
note: Compilation by ThePedro004. Individual model authors are listed in each weapon’s credits.txt; the source also credits nadalao, Firefly and Ezekiel.

name: Neutral Grip
author: void
description: Changes the neutral hold used by suitable weapons for the player and pedestrians.

name: Weapon Details • Light Version
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Adds visual detail to weapon handling and moving parts.
note: This collection uses the Light Version. Do not assume all features of the full release are enabled.

name: Weapon Change Anim Fixed
author: Razor1096, Alvian9xpro, Artem, TheNoiceCat
description: Adds and fixes animations for drawing and changing weapons.

name: Spread Fix
author: Ryosuke839
description: Corrects the original circular bullet-spread pattern.

name: Faithful Weapons Sounds Pack
author: Strelok, Navaro, ThePedro004
description: Replacement weapon sounds supplied with the Faithful Weapons Pack.
note: This is the sound component of the weapon pack, kept as a separate Mod Loader folder.

name: Uncompressed SFX Pack
author: MrFinger, Matt1010
description: Higher-quality source recordings for many of the original sound effects, including numerous vehicle engines.
note: Coverage is extensive, but it does not replace every sound in the game.

name: Weapon Handling Sounds
author: pedrowav, Infinity Ward
description: Adds sounds when handling, aiming and switching weapons.
note: Script by pedrowav; audio credits include Infinity Ward’s Modern Warfare (2019). Weapon switching uses Weapon Change Anim Fixed.

name: Radio Effects
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Radio interference and interruption effects give in-car audio more context.

name: Rain Audio Fix
author: Ezekiel, Junior_Djjr
description: New rain and thunder audio, including rain heard inside interiors.

name: SleekUI
author: pedrowav
description: The main interface overhaul, with redesigned HUD elements, animated counters and modern presentation.

name: SleekConfig
author: pedrowav
description: Configuration component accompanying the Sleek mods.
note: Kept as part of the supplied Sleek setup, not presented as a separate visual overhaul.

name: SleekHitmarkers
author: pedrowav
description: Visual hit feedback during combat.

name: CustomCrosshairs v2
author: HzanRsxa2959, DK22Pac
description: Allows different crosshair textures for individual weapons.
note: HzanRsxa2959 is the author; DK22Pac is credited for assistance.

name: Damage Mark
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: An on-screen marker points towards the source of incoming damage.

name: On-Screen Reloading
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Displays reloading feedback on screen.

name: On-Screen Replenishment
author: Artem.1.9.9.6 (ArtemQa146)
description: Shows the amount of ammo, health, armour or money gained.

name: PC Key Icons
author: emil6strutui, Rizenberg
description: Keyboard icons for on-screen control prompts.

name: More Radar Icons
author: Junior_Djjr, Rill24_ (iceman_)
description: Adds map and radar markers for more places around the state.
note: Present in the latest inventory. The site records the current collection, not the earlier UI experiments.

name: Wanted Radar Warning
author: Neon
description: The radar flashes to draw attention to your wanted status.

name: Void Weapon Wheel 1.5
author: void
description: A radial weapon selector with mouse and gamepad support.

name: Void Radio Wheel 0.7 Beta
author: void
description: A radial selector for radio stations, including user tracks.

name: Mobile Font Fixed
author: Junior_Djjr, Rockstar Games
description: A corrected version of the sharper font from the mobile release.

name: Loadscreens 2K Definitive
author: Jéssica Natália, Junior_Djjr
description: Widescreen loading artwork in higher resolution, based on the classic illustrations.
note: The source offers 2K and 4K variants. The installed folder identifies the 2K edition. Original artwork by Rockstar; additional thanks to Paul_Babon.

name: Essentials Pack
author: MixMods, component authors
description: The base collection of loaders and essential PC fixes used by the pack.
note: The key components confirmed in the setup are also credited individually below.

name: Mod Loader
author: Link2012
description: Loads and prioritises replacement files from separate mod folders.

name: SilentPatch
author: Silent
description: Fixes a wide range of original PC bugs and technical issues.

name: Widescreen Fix
author: ThirteenAG, contributors
description: Corrects widescreen presentation and related display issues.
note: Included through _ESSENTIALS.

name: Windowed Mode
author: ThirteenAG
description: Controls windowed and borderless display behaviour.
note: The fullscreen configuration used in this collection was adjusted during setup.

name: Framerate Vigilante
author: GTAmodding contributors
description: Addresses framerate-dependent behaviour and supplies a configurable FPS cap.
note: For Fender Ketchup, set FPSlimit = 30 in [Settings], restart the game and replay the mission. Restore your previous value afterwards.

name: GInput
author: Silent
description: Improved controller support, also used by mods that offer gamepad controls.

name: CLEO
author: CLEO Library team
description: Runs the custom scripts used throughout the collection.
note: The installed CLEO support plugins include FileSystem Operations, IniFiles and IntOperations.

name: CLEO+
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Additional scripting functions required by many of the gameplay and world mods.

name: NewOpcodes
author: DK22Pac
description: Additional CLEO commands used by the interface and other scripted mods.

name: Effect Loader
author: DK22Pac
description: Loads separate effect definitions without replacing the whole effects file.

name: Open Limit Adjuster
author: Link2012, GTAmodding contributors
description: Expands selected engine limits for a larger modded installation.

name: Improved Streaming
author: Junior_Djjr, ThirteenAG
description: Changes how game assets are kept and loaded in memory.
note: Kept in the latest collection. Initial loading and streaming stutter are still observed; no new memory configuration is claimed for this edition.

name: MixSets
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Used here for the exit-crash workaround.
note: The setup selected the all-disabled preset, enabled the mod, and set SkipShutdown = 1. This skips shutdown cleanup; it does not diagnose or repair gameplay crashes.

name: Ped Task Crash Fix
author: Tornholio
description: Guards against two specific crashes involving invalid pedestrian-task pointers.
note: A targeted protection for those crashes, not a guarantee that every animation or pedestrian mod is compatible.

name: ShoppingDat Limit Adjuster
author: Source not identified
description: The installed shopping-data limit plugin is retained in the inventory.
note: Recorded as ShoppingDatLimitAdjusterSA.asi. Its original author and release page still need confirmation from the included readme.

name: CrashInfo
author: Junior_Djjr
description: Records crash information to help diagnose problems.
note: A diagnostic component rather than a crash-prevention mod.

name: NoDEP
author: Fabio
description: Compatibility component included as _noDEP.asi.
note: Loaded from the game directory as part of the support files.
